title: Concept: Plugin object or embed loads over plaintext HTTP on an HTTPS page
description: A plaintext plugin object on an HTTPS page means the embedded document arrives over an unprotected channel while the page around it is authenticated. Anything the embedded document can do runs in the origin the user trusts.
applicability: HTTPS responses whose HTML embeds plugin content.
risk: A network attacker rewrites the embedded document and uses it to phish inside the trusted page or to interact with the page origin under the user’s session.
